claims.answer: Electron desktop app for Windows x64, macOS 13+ (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Linux (deb/rpm, x64 and arm64); iOS and Android apps in the stores that pair over an encrypted relay; npx launcher; no browser client or editor extension.

scope.plan: Open source (AGPL-3.0), local desktop with optional relay and SSH hosts

desktop_os.answer: Windows x64 (NSIS), macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon or Intel (dmg/zip), Linux x64/arm64 (deb/rpm); Knowledge Graph unavailable on Intel Macs.

mobile_apps.answer: Kangentic Mobile is on the App Store and Google Play (source in Kangentic/mobile).

browser.answer: No browser client for the board. Bounded search of the pinned source and docs found no implementation.

mobile_browser.answer: No mobile web interface; phones use the apps. Bounded search of the pinned source and docs found no implementation.

cli.answer: npx kangentic downloads, installs and opens the app; the launcher package is in packages/launcher; no CLI to steer tasks (the MCP server serves agents).

editor_extensions.answer: No editor extension. Bounded search of the pinned source and docs found no implementation.

task_actions.answer: Phone can check agents, start/pause sessions, move tasks, answer a stopped agent permission prompt or question, open command and interactive terminals and review a diff.

notifications.answer: Desktop notifications and toasts; mobile push notifications are end-to-end encrypted through Expo with presence suppression.

cross_device_continuity.answer: Paired phone follows the same running sessions through the relay while the desktop runs; one desktop can pair several devices.

limitations: Parts that are partial, unsupported or unknown in the scoped release: browser, mobile_browser, editor_extensions; see the atomic answers.

evidence.title: Workflow engine
evidence.finding: Starts tasks whose blockers are Done up to free slots; recovery of unfinished steps; memory gate; pause/resume.

evidence.title: Session resume
evidence.finding: Resume after restart, crash recovery and recovery attempts.

evidence.title: Default config
evidence.finding: agent.maxConcurrentSessions default 8.

evidence.title: PR linking code
evidence.finding: Finds and records PRs by number, pushed branch and commit tiers; no PR-creation call.

evidence.title: GitHub connector code
evidence.finding: gh pr view/list based reads; no gh pr create.

evidence.title: Packaging config
evidence.finding: Targets Windows NSIS, macOS dmg/zip and Linux deb/rpm.

evidence.title: Cursor adapter buildCommand
evidence.finding: Adapters build a shell command per agent through buildCommand; the Cursor adapter returns a resume before -p, so at least one adapter passes the prompt as a command-line argument.

evidence.title: AGPL-3.0 licence text
evidence.finding: GNU Affero General Public License version 3.

evidence.title: Security policy
evidence.finding: Reporting channel for security issues; no certification claim.

evidence.title: Changelog
evidence.finding: Per-release changelog.

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.finding: 142 stars at the check; AGPL-3.0; homepage kangentic.com; last push 2026-11-17.

evidence.title: Release v0.59.0
evidence.finding: Published 2026-11-17 (commit b67c723); assets: NSIS exe, dmg and zip for arm64/x64, deb and rpm for x64/arm64, Linux host tarballs and update manifests; v0.58.0 2026-11-13, v0.57.1 2026-11-12, v0.57.0 2026-11-11.

evidence.title: Kangentic Mobile repository
evidence.finding: Public AGPL-3.0 TypeScript (Expo) mobile app repository; apps are on the App Store and Google Play per the README.

evidence.title: Kangentic relay repository
evidence.finding: Public AGPL-3.0 blind WebSocket rendezvous relay for the mobile companion; hostable by users.

evidence.title: README board image
evidence.finding: Real Kangentic board screenshot on vendor sample project contoso-web.

evidence.title: Kangentic documentation site
evidence.finding: First-party documentation site mirrored by docs/ in the repository.

evidence.title: Bounded search: telemetry
evidence.finding: Aptabase analytics and Sentry error reporting exist (src/main/analytics); both enabled in release builds by default.

evidence.title: Bounded search: vendor cloud execution
evidence.locator: rg -i "cloud agent|hosted agent|managed cloud|sandbox vm" src/main README.md docs/user-guide
evidence.finding: No vendor-hosted agent execution; README says it is not for people who want agents in the cloud; the only vendor service is the optional mobile relay and push relay.

evidence.title: Bounded search: roles, SSO, shared sessions
evidence.finding: No roles, SSO, org or seat model; teammates share only kangentic.json through git.

evidence.title: Bounded search: living specifications
evidence.locator: rg -i "living spec|requirements doc|product spec|prd" src/main docs/user-guide
evidence.finding: No maintained product-requirements feature; artifacts are links to external documents.

evidence.title: Bounded search: PR create and merge actions
evidence.finding: Reads PR state and readiness only; no PR creation or merge call.

evidence.title: Bounded search: container/VM/OS sandbox
evidence.finding: No container or VM isolation for agents; per-agent permission modes only.

evidence.title: Kangentic analytics gate and Privacy tab
evidence.finding: Aptabase analytics and Sentry error reports are on in packaged builds unless KANGENTIC_TELEMETRY=0/false (or KANGENTIC_ERROR_REPORTING=0 for errors). The Settings Privacy tab only describes the data and the environment variables; it has no toggle.
